description: This file defines extension methods for the Socket class in the Orleans networking library, providing functionalities to enable TCP loopback fast path and TCP keep-alive options.

classes.name: SocketExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring socket options related to performance optimization.

methods.name: EnableFastPath
methods.description: Enables TCP Loopback Fast Path for the socket if running on Windows 8 or later, improving loopback performance.

methods.name: EnableKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive with configurable timing options to maintain active socket connections.
